title: EMplified Scan: Integrated Solution for 4D STEM Experiments
content: With the advent of fast cameras, their application in STEM enables sophisticated analysis, such as strain mapping, ptychography, phase contrast analysis and phase orientation mapping. Successful experiments require intimate interaction of several devices, often by different manufacturers, such as microscope, a scan generator with the ability to generate or accept synchronization signals and a pixel detector. Oftentimes, the beam sensitive sample renders finding an interesting sample position and successful acquisition of a meaningful dataset a challenging task.
